text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Arima Kinen arrives. Vodka's rival, Daiwa Scarlet, is enthusiastic to be number one in both position and popularity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, Vodka wonders how cool it really is to continue competing with Daiwa Scarlet and simply chase after strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, mulling over things forever is unquestionably lame. She pulls herself together and gets ready for the last race of the year: the Arima Kinen.
